name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with no more than three wheels on the ground and a saddle the rider sits astride; an electric one whose motor produces more than 5 horsepower (about 3,750 W) is a full motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle. Defined by Rhode Island General Laws §31-1-3(n).

restrictions.rule: A saddle the rider sits astride, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces more than 5 horsepower (about 3,750 W)
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle (M) endorsement, which requires being 16 or older and completing a CCRI motorcycle safety course; motorcycle permits are no longer issued
Riders under 21, and every rider in the first year after their motorcycle license is issued, must wear an approved helmet
Riders must wear approved eye protection
Registered with the DMV as a motorcycle
One built for off-road use that the DMV won't register for the road is a recreational vehicle instead
